panels.title: Agent Up
panels.description: Prometheus scrape health of the agent's /metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Tracked Flows
panels.description: Distinct flow keys tracked in GlobalState. Thresholds mark the telemetry_map sizing budget (yellow 50k, red 65k).

panels.title: Attached Interfaces
panels.description: Interfaces currently carrying the TC telemetry programs (netlink Interface Registry size).

panels.title: Neutron Sync Age
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful Neutron cold-start or reconcile. "never synced" means the agent is running without tenant metadata.

panels.title: Last Scrape Age
panels.description: Seconds since the scraper last drained the kernel BPF map successfully. Should hover near the 10s scrape interval.

panels.title: telemetry_map fill
panels.description: Kernel flow-map occupancy (current/max entries). Pressure-relief GC triggers at 80%.

panels.title: Bytes/sec by direction
panels.description: Billed byte rate split by direction (tx = sent by the VM, rx = received by the VM), summed over all tenants and zones.

panels.title: Packets/sec by direction
panels.description: Billed packet rate split by direction (tx = sent by the VM, rx = received by the VM), summed over all tenants and zones.

panels.title: Bytes/sec by zone
panels.description: Byte rate by destination zone (external / same_tenant / other_tenant / infra / shared / miss), stacked.

panels.title: Top tenants by bytes (1m rate)
panels.description: Ten highest-throughput tenant IDs over the last minute.

panels.title: Cumulative bytes by (zone, direction)
panels.description: Lifetime billed bytes per (zone, direction). Cumulative across agent restarts — the WAL preserves continuity.

panels.title: Map fill ratio
panels.description: Occupancy per kernel map (current/max entries). telemetry_map crossing the 0.8 red line triggers pressure-relief GC.

panels.title: Map entries (current vs max)
panels.description: Absolute entry counts vs compiled-in capacity for each kernel BPF map.

panels.title: Scrape errors
panels.description: Failed BPF-map drain attempts. Any sustained nonzero rate puts billing data at risk.

panels.title: Time since last successful scrape
panels.description: Scrape lag. Sustained growth means the drain loop is stuck or erroring.

panels.title: Collect pass duration (p50 / p99)
panels.description: Time to serve one Prometheus collection: GlobalState snapshot + per-tenant aggregation + emission. Scales with flows x CPUs; must stay well under the scrape interval.

panels.title: Neutron API errors (rate over 5m)
panels.description: Failed Neutron API calls by endpoint and code. Flat zero lines are healthy: each endpoint is seeded at 0 under the "network" code class; HTTP status codes appear on first occurrence.

panels.title: BuildTrie avg step duration
panels.description: Average duration of each cold-start trie-build step (catchall, owned, shared, infra, extra-routes). Recorded once per cold-start/reconcile.

panels.title: Unknown device_owner admissions
panels.description: Port admissions whose device_owner is outside the IsKnownVMOwner allowlist. The owner label space is open-ended, so a synthetic "none | 0" row stands in until a real admission occurs.

panels.title: Topology anomalies (by class)
panels.description: lachesis_neutron_anomalies from the last sync/reconcile pass. Gauge semantics: a fixed misconfiguration drops back to 0. multi_external_path = VMs whose external_network attribution is a deterministic pick among several candidates (billing approximate; drill down at /debug/anomalies).

panels.title: WAL phase latency (p99 over 5m)
panels.description: p99 latency per WAL flush phase. Only the copy phase holds the GlobalState lock; SLO is write+fsync+rename p99 < 50ms (red line).

panels.title: WAL flush failures / load fallbacks
panels.description: WAL flush failures by sub-stage and boot-load fallbacks, as 5m increments. Flat zero is healthy: all stage and fallback label values are seeded at 0.

panels.title: Attached interfaces
panels.description: Interface Registry size over time; steps follow VM create/delete on this host.

panels.title: TC attach failures (rate over 5m)
panels.description: TC clsact attach failures from the netlink subscriber. Flat zero lines are healthy: both iface_kind values (tap, other) are seeded at 0.

panels.title: Zombie filters cleaned at boot
panels.description: Orphaned TC filters removed at boot, left over from a previous crashed run. Nonzero after a clean restart deserves a look.

panels.title: UnresolvedBuffer depth
panels.description: UnresolvedBuffer occupancy. Hard cap 10,000 (memory bound, Contract #1); SLO is <1000 sustained. Yellow=SLO breach, red=near-cap panic. Sustained near-cap means a no-Neutron deployment, an unknown-MAC flood, or a Kafka outage (S7).

panels.title: GC evictions & runs (rate over 5m)
panels.description: Per-second eviction activity. gc ttl = lingering-ghost expiry (mac_tenant_map); gc pressure_relief = oldest-flow eviction at >80% telemetry_map fill; gc ghost_residual_flow = a swept MAC's residual telemetry_map flows removed so they are not re-billed as "unknown"; buffer lru/expired = UnresolvedBuffer entries folded to "unknown".

panels.title: Lingering ghosts & late-binding
panels.description: Lingering ghosts = metadata entries inside the 60s deletion grace window. resolved/s is the late-binding success path — stays zero until the Kafka consumer (S7) can resolve a buffered MAC.

panels.title: Kafka consumer lag
panels.description: Messages the notification consumer is behind the topic head. Sustained growth means the agent is falling back on the periodic reconcile; suggested alert: lag > 1000 sustained.

panels.title: Kafka consume errors (rate over 5m)
panels.description: Failed reads from Kafka (broker unreachable, fetch errors); the consumer logs and retries with backoff.

panels.title: Reconcile passes (rate over 5m)
panels.description: Periodic + Kafka-kicked Neutron reconcile passes by outcome: ok = applied & committed; sync_error = Neutron fetch failed; apply_error = a kernel write failed and state was not committed (retried next pass).

panels.title: Unbilled ratio (revenue-leak SLO, 5m)
panels.description: Share of observed bytes that cannot be attributed to any tenant (miss zone or unknown tenant) — the fraction of traffic billing cannot invoice. Target: below 0.1%. Known inflater until the multicast zone lands: platform-L2 multicast (mDNS/SSDP) arriving on provider-attached taps counts here.

panels.title: Unattributed traffic (miss zone / unknown tenant)
panels.description: The two unbillable streams behind the ratio: bytes whose destination could not be classified (miss) and bytes whose VM MAC is not known to the metadata layer (unknown). Persistent flow here means lost revenue or platform chatter — drill down at /debug/anomalies and /debug/lookup.

panels.title: Settled folds (attribution deaths)
panels.description: How often flow records are folded into the per-tenant settled totals — this happens when a VM is deleted or its attribution changes. A burst here is normal after teardown waves; it also means per-server series just ended on this node.
